description: Inventario Alumbrado Público (Modelo de prestación de servicios AP) is a dataset listed in City of Bogotá open data portal (Datos Abiertos Bogotá), an open data portal, published or maintained by Unidad Administrativa Especial de Servicios Públicos - UAESP. Inventario Alumbrado Público (Modelo de prestación de servicios AP) de Junio a Noviembre del 2021. Coverage: Bogotá. The portal files it under the publisher Unidad Administrativa Especial de Servicios Públicos - UAESP. It offers 7 resource(s) in XLSX. The portal shows 2023-08-31 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution Share-Alike 4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bogota-portal.
